verdict.rationale: PayPal documents accepting debit and credit cards online and offers no-code Payment Links that can be shared on a website, so a founder could plausibly take a card payment quickly. However, nothing in the evidence documents signup or onboarding time, account verification steps, or that the first card payment can be taken within a day. Missing for 10: documented signup-to-first-payment timeline, onboarding/verification flow evidence, hands-on corroboration of same-day card acceptance.

support.subject: As a founder, I can accept an online card payment within a day of signing up

citations.quote: Offer up to 400M users1 the choice to pay with PayPal, Venmo, Pay Later, debit and credit cards, and more.
Swiftly create a Payment Link to share on your website, via email, on social media, or through text. No coding skills required.
PayPal Open helps you accept payments online, in person, and on the go.
